title: Geometry oracle false-negative still triple-delivers narration on the retries-exhausted path (CAM-373 residue)
description:
MEASURED LIVE this session (CAM-372 cycle, on binary 0.223.0 which already carries the CAM-373 fix). The operator's pane received the line `[cam] merge-watch: PR #300 BEHIND, ran gh pr update-branch (attempt 1/2)` THREE times, identical. The event log carries exactly ONE corresponding event:

    {"kind":"push-undelivered","detail":{"paneId":"%0","retriesExhausted":3,"reason":"retries-exhausted"}}

All three sends really landed. The oracle judged each one undelivered and retried.

WHAT CAM-373 DID AND DID NOT FIX. CAM-373 made sendKeysVerified (src/tmux/dispatch.ts) send EXACTLY ONCE when the pre-send idle gate times out, emitting reason 'pane-not-idle' with retriesExhausted 1. That path is now provably correct: five 'pane-not-idle' events in this same log, every one retriesExhausted:1. But the fix was scoped to the case where the code KNOWS the geometry oracle's precondition (an idle pane) is violated and consults it anyway.

THE RESIDUE: when the pane IS detected idle, the precondition HOLDS, the oracle is consulted legitimately, and it STILL returns a false negative. The unconditional `for attempt <= maxAttempts` loop then runs to exhaustion and delivers the same narration up to 3 times. This is a different defect from CAM-373 (precondition violated) and from CAM-361 (the 30s blocking window, which is what made these three lines ARRIVE after the operator had already observed PR #300 MERGED: that is reordering, not duplication). All three now have distinct, separately-measured causes.

WHY IT MATTERS: duplicate narration is not cosmetic. The orchestrator narrates from these lines, and a triplicated merge-watch line reads as three separate BEHIND events / three update-branch attempts when exactly one occurred. That is actively misleading state for a human reading the pane, and it misled this session's narration until the event log was probed.

SUSPECTED DIRECTION (NOT verified, needs its own grounding pass before any spec): the cursor-geometry pair can read unchanged for a send that did land. This is the residue already documented honestly in the dispatch.ts module header: the prompt-row discriminator is consulted ONLY when the geometry pair reads unchanged, so a payload whose wrap row starts with '>' or U+276F can forge an empty-composer reading. A candidate fix is dedup-on-identical-payload within a short window, making a repeat send unrepresentable regardless of the oracle's verdict, which is robust against ANY future oracle false-negative. The alternative is hardening the oracle itself, which the CAM-359 / CAM-364 / CAM-373 sequence suggests is a losing game: three consecutive cycles have now narrowed this oracle without eliminating its false-negative class.

SIDECAR-EXECUTED: needs a coherence rebuild after merge.

REPRODUCIBLE EVIDENCE: grep -o '"kind":"push-undelivered"[^}]*}' .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl | tail -10
